phase: initial (frozen, written before any TLC/Go execution)
overall_reason: The update bundles three behavior changes that touch the old suite: (1) learners now cast votes (raft.go Step, TestLearnerCannotVote -> TestLearnerCanVote, long design comment) which falsifies the learner-silence parts of VoteContract and the grant conjunct of LearnerEligibility; (2) RawNode.Ready() now accepts (clears msgs/readStates, updates prevSoftSt) and Advance() no longer does (rawnode.go doc contract + TestRawNodeConsumeReady), which falsifies the raw branch of ReadyOwnership, requires an Advance-retention obligation and changes the meaning of the lostReads observer behind ReadyAccounting; (3) newRaft and restore() now rebuild the full joint ConfState via confchange.Restore - this is exactly what the existing JointSnapshotRecovery/ConfigurationOrigin already require (old code violated them), so those are kept, not edited. ConfState field renames, Visit ordering, logger mutex, quorum slice refactor and node.go plumbing are representation-only or unobservable in the model. Core safety properties are kept as controls.

entries.evidence: new/source/raft.go Step case MsgVote/MsgPreVote: `if r.isLearner {... return nil}` removed and replaced by a design comment explaining learners must vote (promoted learner that has not applied the promotion yet). raft_test.go: TestLearnerCannotVote renamed TestLearnerCanVote and now expects exactly one MsgVoteResp. Lease check and stale-term handling unchanged.
entries.old_expression: grant==~lease /\ ~stale /\ ~o.learner /\ fresh /\ can ; silence==lease \/ (stale /\ m.type="MsgVote") \/ (~stale /\ o.learner)
entries.proposed_expression: grant==~lease /\ ~stale /\ fresh /\ can ; silence==lease \/ (stale /\ m.type="MsgVote")  (rest of VoteContract unchanged; observer VoteObservation unchanged, learner field retained for diagnostics)
entries.disagreement_state: Node 2 is a learner (config voters={1}, learners={2}), follower, term 1, vote 0, lead 0, empty log, checkQuorum off. It receives MsgVote{from 1, term 2, logTerm 11, index 11}. New code replies MsgVoteResp{term 2, reject FALSE} and sets vote=1: old VoteContract FALSE (expects silence), proposed TRUE. The old-code observation (no response, term 2, vote 0) is old TRUE, proposed FALSE.
entries.controls: Learner that already voted for 3 in term 2 must still reject 1; learner with a more up-to-date log must reject; lease-suppressed learner must stay silent; stale MsgVote silent. Proposed contract must still reject a grant in these states.

entries.evidence: Same as above: learners may now grant (history.grants entries with learner=TRUE become legitimate). Learners still cannot campaign: promotable() unchanged, MsgHup/MsgTimeoutNow still ignored by unpromotable nodes.

entries.controls: history.campaigns containing [node|->2, learner|->TRUE] must still be rejected; a learner MsgHup must produce no campaign record.

entries.evidence: No contract change. ElectionSafety/QuorumAccounting must still hold with learner votes (TallyVotes and JointWon only count voters). PromiseBacking now additionally constrains learner grants (vote durable before MsgVoteResp).

model_migrations_not_property_changes: StepVote: drop `IF r.id\in r.config.learners THEN r ELSE`.
RestoreProjection(cfg) == cfg (full ConfState restore); Restore and RestartCore progress domain = VoterIDs(cfg) \cup cfg.learners.
ProtocolReady: raw nodes also clear out/readStates and set prevSS at Ready.
AdvanceCore: no out/readStates/prevSS changes for raw nodes at Advance.

updated_behaviors_already_covered.behavior: Snapshot restore and restart rebuild the full joint config (outgoing, learnersNext, autoLeave)
updated_behaviors_already_covered.covered_by: JointSnapshotRecovery (history.recovery records compare x.config with x.expectedConfig = snapshot config or ConfigOf(savedApp); live nodes compare config with ConfigOf(cfgHist), which Restore sets to s.hist) and ConfigurationOrigin (config=ConfigOf(cfgHist) for every live node).

updated_behaviors_already_covered.behavior: Learner grants must be durable before being sent
updated_behaviors_already_covered.covered_by: PromiseBacking via ProtocolPublish: MsgVoteResp ~reject requires disk[n].hs.vote=m.to at that term; applies to learners now that they send grants.

updated_behaviors_already_covered.behavior: Learner votes cannot make a non-voter majority
updated_behaviors_already_covered.covered_by: QuorumAccounting (wins need JointWon(w.config,w.yes), which intersects yes with the candidate's voter halves) and ElectionSafety.
LearnerEligibility campaigns conjunct (retained) and CampaignContract (ignore when o.node \notin o.voters).

updated_behaviors_already_covered.behavior: Restored autoLeave joint config eventually appended leave entry when leader
updated_behaviors_already_covered.covered_by: AutoLeaveAdvance (eligible computed from r.config.autoLeave, which is now restored).

suspected_defects_not_to_hide: new restore() still checks self-membership only against cs.Voters and cs.Learners; a node that is only in VotersOutgoing (or LearnersNext) ignores snapshots carrying the joint config, so a lagging outgoing voter cannot catch up while the config is joint (liveness/progress, not safety). The model mirrors this guard; no property edit should mask it.
Old implementation violates JointSnapshotRecovery/ConfigurationOrigin (joint config lost on restore/restart); the property must stay as is.

Old base.tla AdvanceCore clears raw readStates unconditionally whereas old acceptReady clears them only when rd.ReadStates is non-empty; the old lostReads guard `b.reads # <<>>` masks the resulting model loss (pre-existing model/observer defect).
TestLearnerCanVote assertion `msg.Type != pb.MsgVoteResp && !msg.Reject` passes for a rejecting MsgVoteResp; it does not actually check the grant.
Learner votes rely on the candidate's config being current; the code comment points at etcd issue 7625. ElectionSafety/QuorumAccounting stay required.
unresolved_obligations: Liveness motivation for learner voting (promoted-but-unaware learner enables election) is only expressible via ElectionProgress, which is not model-checked in this suite.
Snapshot delivery to outgoing-only voters during joint configs (progress).
Trace instrumentation must rename ConfState fields (Nodes->Voters, NodesJoint->VotersOutgoing); not part of the property suite.
